    """
    Calculates the harmonic sum of n-1.
    H_{n-1} = 1/1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + ... + 1/(n-1)

    """
    Counts the number of characters in a string that occur at the same position 
    in the string as in the English alphabet (case insensitive).

            # The position in the string is i + 1 (since i is 0-indexed)

            # Check if the character's alphabetical position matches its string position

    """
    Checks whether the given array is monotonic or not.
    An array is monotonic if it is either entirely non-decreasing or entirely non-increasing.
    """
    if not arr or len(arr) == 1:
        return True

    is_increasing = True
    is_decreasing = True

    for i in range(len(arr) - 1):
        if arr[i] > arr[i+1]:
            is_increasing = False
        if arr[i] < arr[i+1]:
            is_decreasing = False

    return is_increasing or is_decreasing
